proof.observed: Healthy view: 1.595 µs on main, 1.737 µs at the head. First scan ended by the idle timer (flake B's own shape): 6.2 ms on main and RolesHeldBy still refuses right after, 1.027 s at the head and RolesHeldBy answers - the wait is one rescanDelay (kvwatch.go:152, 1 s).
